verdict.rationale: Only community reports show that Box ships desktop sync clients on macOS (OS X) and Windows, and they describe CPU spikes and clunkiness. No first-party docs cover the clients, and nothing in the pack shows selective sync or online-only files. The agent-runtime POSIX mount is a different capability and earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party desktop client documentation, selective sync evidence, on-demand/online-only files evidence, hands-on corroboration that sync 'just works'.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files

citations.quote: The Box client used to spike CPU at 100% on OS X when you have a folder hierarchy with a lot of small files
the desktop client seems a lot clunkier than Dropbox (Windows 7)
